description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up view of a black and silver ergonomic keyboard placed on a wooden desk surface. The keyboard has a curved, contoured design with a wrist rest at the bottom. It features standard QWERTY keys with white lettering on black keycaps. Above the main keyboard area, there is a row of multimedia and shortcut keys, including buttons labeled "My Documents," "My Pictures," "My Music," "Mail," "Calculator," "Internet," and others
